senses.gloss: उर [ura], a. Going (Ved.). -रः A sheep.
उरा [urā], Ved. A ewe. अवीरे क्रतौ वि दविद्युतन्नोरा न मायुं Rv.1.95.3.
उरगः [uragḥ], (-गी f.) [उरसा गच्छति, उरस् -गम्-ड; सलोपश्च P.III.2.48 Vārt.]
A serpent, snake; अङ्गुली- वोरगक्षता R.1.28,12.5,91. उपगांश्च दिव्यान् Bg.11.15.
A Nāga or semi-divine serpent usually represented in mythology with a human face; देवगन्धर्वमानुषोरगराक्षसान् Nala.1.28; Ms.3.196.
(पुं. न.) Lead. -गा N. of a city; अथोरगाख्यस्य पुरस्य नाथम् R.6.59. -गी A female snake.
Comp. अरिः अशनः, शत्रुः N. of Garuḍa (enemy of snakes); Śi.5.13.

peacock. -आस्यम् a kind of spade (serpent-shaped hoe); -इन्द्रः, -राजः N. of Vāsuki or Śeṣa. -प्रतिसर a. having a serpent for a wedding ring. -बन्धः A class of bases (of columns &c.) shaped like the face of a snake. -भूषणः N. of Śiva (decked with serpents). -सारचन्दनः, -नम् a kind of sandal-wood. -स्थानम् the abode of the Nāgas, i. e. Pātāla.
उरङ्गः [uraṅgḥ] गमः [gamḥ], गमः A snake.
उरचर [uracara], a. Accessory, supplementary.
रः Access, approach.
Cure, treatment; त्वग्भेदी व्रणः सूपचरः easily curable.
उपचरणम् Approach.
उरणः [uraṇḥ], [Uṇ.5.17.] (-णी f.)
A ram, sheep; वृकीवोरणमासाद्य मृत्युरादाय गच्छति Mb., Bhāg.9.14,27.
A certain demon killed by Indra. -णी A ewe.-Comp. -अक्षः, -क्षकः, -आख्यः the plant Cassia Alata or Tora. An esculent and medicinal plant (Mar. टाकळा). -णम् Silver.
उरणकः [uraṇakḥ], 1 A ram. उरणका इमे बर्करा इमे Mbh. on P. I.2.73 एतावुरणकौ राजन्न्यासौ रक्षस्व मानद Bhāg.9.14.21.
A cloud.
उरभ्रः [urabhrḥ], 1 A ram, देवि पश्याम उरभ्रसंवादं किं मुधा वेतनदानेन M.1.
The plant Cassia Alata (Mar. टाकळा)
सारिका A kind of poisonous insect.

उररी [urarī], ind. [ऊर्यादिच्विडाचश्च P.I.4.61] A particle implying (1) assent, admission or acceptance. (In this sense it is usually used with the roots कृ, भू, or अस् and it has the force of a गति or preposition; उररीकृत्य not उररी- कृत्वा. Other forms of the word are उरी, उरुरी, ऊरी and ऊरुरी.); (2) Extension.
ऊररी [ūrarī], = उररी q. v.
उररीकारः [urarīkārḥ], Promise, agreement, admission.
उररीकृ [urarīkṛ], 8 U. To consent, allow, accept; गिरं न कां कामुररीचकार Bv.2.13; M.5; Dk.12; Śi.1.14.
उररीकृत [urarīkṛta], p. p.
Promised, agreed, accepted.
Spread, extended.
उरल [urala], a. Moving (Ved.).
उरसिलोमन् [urasilōman], a. Having hair on the breast.
उरस् [uras], a. Best, excellent. n. (उरः) The breast, bosom; व्यूढोरस्को वृषस्कन्धः R.1.13; Ku.6.51; उरसि कृ to clasp to the bosom.
Comp. कटः the sacrificial thread hung round the neck and upon the breast.

an upper garment (for boys). -कपाटः A broad strong chest. -क्षतम् injury to the chest. -क्षयः Consumption, a disease in the chest. -गामिन् a. going on the breast (as a reptile), creeping, crawling. -ग्रहः, -घातः a disease of the chest, pleurisy. -छदः, -त्राणम् a cuirass, breast-plate; Śi.15.8. cf. also उरच्छदमनिर्भिद्य द्रुतमुत्प- तिताः शराः Śiva. B.13.1.6. -जः, -भूः, उरसिजः, उरसिरुहः the female breast; रेजाते रुचिरदृशामुरोजकुम्भौ Śi.8.53, उरसिरुहेण हारलीलाम् 25,59. -भूषणम् an ornament of the breast. -सूत्रिका a necklace of pearls hanging over the breast. -स्तम्भः Oppression of the chest, asthma. -स्थलम् the breast, bosom.
उरस्तस् [urastas], ind. From the breast, towards the bosom.
उरस्य [urasya], a. [उरस्-यत्]
Being in the breast.
Pectoral.
Requiring an effort of the chest (as any exertion).
Legitimate (a son or daughter); born from a married couple of the same tribe or caste.
Excellent.
स्यः A son.
The female breast; Bṛi. S.
उरस्यति [urasyati], Den. P. To be strong.
उरस्वत् [urasvat] उरसिल [urasila], उरसिल a. Broad-chested, full-breasted.
उराहः [urāhḥ], A horse of a pale colour with dark legs.
ऊरव्यः [ūravyḥ], Born from the thighs, hence a वैश्य, a merchant; विप्राश्च बाहुजास्तद्वदूरव्याश्च जघन्यजाः Śiva. B.31.17.
ऊरव्यः [ūravyḥ], (-व्या f.) [ऊरु-यत्] A Vaiśya, a man of the third tribe (as born from the thighs of Brahmā or Puruṣa); cf. Ms.1.31,87.
